longDescription: Open Aixcut, import local media and documents, read a project before editing, then cut, caption, dub, score, generate assets and export in natural language while verifying each step.
tryPrompts: Open my Aixcut project and read the timeline before editing
Remove mistakes and pauses from this talking-head clip and caption it
Generate a voiceover and background music, assemble a 30-second cut and export it

aixcut-basics.description: Shared Aixcut MCP rules: read-before-write, stable refs, idempotency, async jobs, error envelopes, and host boundaries. Load it when no specialist skill applies.

aixcut-captions.description: Create, edit, split, and style Aixcut captions, and keep them in sync with voice or speech.

aixcut-documents.description: Import a user-provided local document into an Aixcut project library.

aixcut-export.description: Export an Aixcut project as MP4, MOV, or WebM and check the page-based export status and result.

aixcut-generation.description: Generate images, videos, or music in Aixcut and track asynchronous generation jobs.

aixcut-host.description: Aixcut's Kimi host adapter: OAuth, built-in browser handoff, local media, workflow storage, and export delivery.

aixcut-known-errors.description: Triage rejected Aixcut calls by stable error code.

aixcut-login.description: Check the Aixcut MCP OAuth login state without opening a web page.

aixcut-mcp-logout.description: Sign out of Aixcut MCP, revoke the OAuth grant, and clear the local credential.

aixcut-projects.description: List, create, open, switch, or exit Aixcut projects.

aixcut-talking-head.description: Edit speech-led videos such as interviews, courses, and podcasts, removing mistakes and pauses.

aixcut-timeline-editing.description: Edit Aixcut clips, text, audio, tracks, and canvas, and import local media.

aixcut-verification.description: Read-only verification of Aixcut structure, timeline, voice, captions, and renderability.

aixcut-video-assembly.description: Assemble a complete video by coordinating visuals, voiceover, captions, music, and export.

aixcut-voice.description: Write voiceover scripts, select a voice, synthesize speech, and optionally place it on the timeline.
